summary: Spawned in the Backrooms is a persistent survival RPG across Level 0, the Hub and authored Backrooms destinations. Player.state holds character progression and gear while Solo/Multiplayer run-story state is switched separately; shared player behaviors and quest systems connect the places. Level 69's repeatable highway exits now include a car-carrying ramp to Level 22, Emstable's six-deck ruin; a creator-facing Asset Library mod catalogs and builds reusable assets and scene sets.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, routes and anomalies; Bonus Rooms door is north of the waking point in x0z0.
places/bonus + places/testlab (3D) - vaporwave mall, homes, atlas Teleport Station, interactive props and creator/body fixtures; glass-side Level 0 hall returns to the Lobby.
places/thehub (3D) - tunnel crossroads and Camp Amber; sim/helpers compose doors, destinations, crews and local interactions.
places/intake (3D), places/laundromat (solo ephemeral) and places/tutorial0 (solo ephemeral) - fresh-player creator/opening chain, laundromat cut and tutorial room/guidance.
places/levelrun (solo ephemeral) - Level ! hospital chase, hazards, pursuers, intro/retry/rescue cuts and Safe Alcove.
places/level325 (3D) - Boom Town; sim lays Wren Adeyemi's M.E.G. survey camp and Level 69 sedan beside her.

places/level69 (solo ephemeral) - The Road Trip of Affliction; highway slices repeat the Level 11 tunnel and Level 22 right-hand ramp at 2.4 km intervals; car, survey posts, encounters and transitions.

places/level22 (solo ephemeral) - Emstable, Ruins Left Behind: six car-park decks from privileged upper floors through working tiers to mined-out lower floors, scaffold Cuts, unstable slabs, records, supplies and a Level 21 rubble exit.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer/player entry, camera and ordered player behavior/actions; shared locomotion, interaction, combat, inventory, social, camera and quest stack.
templates/player.js inserts scripts/god-kit.js before scripts/player.js - builder-only god-mode toggle and refill precede core player update/death handling.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/lib/run-opts.js - per-player arrival, fresh-character and mode/run routing; main-menu-ui.js renders title/pause and expedition settings.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, static placements and generation/tick behavior; sims also run environmental and sign/surface passes.
places/level69/config.yaml + places/level69/sim.js - solo ephemeral highway instance, seat/car transitions and repeatable exit ramps; scripts/l69-car.js owns vehicle control.
places/level22/config.yaml + places/level22/sim.js - solo ephemeral Emstable generation/tick, deck dressing, structural hazards, return exit and incoming car.
scripts/l22-deck-geo.js + scripts/l22-cut-geo.js + scripts/l22-panel-geo.js - procedural deck, shaft and falling-panel geometry driven by scripts/lib/l22-layout.js.
mods/asset-library/mod.json + mods/asset-library/god.js + panel.js - creator-facing asset/set library UI and in-world tools; capture, stage, previews and effect controls are mod components.
shared: scripts/lib/level69-quest.js - Wren dialogue choices/handler and beacon planting; used by talk/dialogue wiring and scripts/l69-post.js.
scripts/lib/level22-quest.js - Level 22 exploration/record quest state, journal synchronization and Wren turn-in; used by sim, l22-record.js, npc-starters.js and talk.js.
scripts/lib/places.js - canonical place names/labels/HUD titles and valid atlas destinations; consumed by feed, quests and scripts/ui.js; includes Levels 22 and 69.
scripts/lib/levelrun-mechanics.js + levelrun-dress.js + levelrun-cut.js - Level ! corridor/hazard rules, hospital dressing and intro/retry/blackout/rescue cuts shared by run components.
scripts/lib/l69-cut.js - L69_INTRO_LEN and player-local opening-camera sequence; lazily loaded and driven by scripts/main-menu.js.
scripts/lib/survival.js + scripts/lib/afk.js - needs-aware stamina recovery/status and AFK tracking; player.js, craft.js and craft-ui.js consume them.
scripts/lib/grid-path.js - configurable 4-neighbor grid BFS/cache/cell selection shared by Level 0, 1, 2, 2.1, 3, Boiler and 6 adapters.

mods/asset-library/lib/store.js + catalog/local shards - asset normalization, search, tags, sets, effects and motion metadata; consumed by Asset Library UI/tools; scripts/lib/geom.js is the editable geometry helper shared by its home/military generators.
notableExports: places/level69/sim.js - cadence, ghostPass, tick, noop; scripts/l69-car.js - lights, ears, ignite, onSpawn, onControlBegin, onControlEnd, onInput, onCollide, update, onOutOfBounds.
scripts/lib/level69-quest.js - WREN, Q69, plantBeacon, l69Choices, handleDialogueQuest69; scripts/l69-road-geo.js - geometry, collider.
places/level22/sim.js - cadence, tick; scripts/l22-record.js - ears; scripts/l22-exit.js - onTriggerEnter.
scripts/lib/level22-quest.js - Q22, startL22, noteFloor, noteRecord, l22Choices, handleDialogueQuest22; scripts/lib/l22-layout.js - deck, cut, panel and zone geometry constants/helpers.
scripts/god-kit.js - onInput, update; templates/player.js - player; scripts/lib/places.js - PLACES, PLACE_NAMES, PLACE_LABELS, LEVEL_TITLES.
mods/asset-library/capture.js - skippable, liveBoxes, clearBoxes, placeBox, onInput; capture-box.js - corners, skippable, inside, editor.
mods/asset-library/stage.js - extents, updateSchedule, update; mods/asset-library/effect-plate.js - parentOf, label, editor; lib/store.js exports search/normalization/catalog serialization helpers.
scripts/lib/geom.js - geometry helpers imported by Asset Library home and military generators.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - durable character player.state: progression/XP, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, combat, access, appearance, currency and gear shared across Solo/Multiplayer.
scripts/lib/stats.js - derived attributes, skills and combat/carry stats; scripts/lib/progression.js migrates progression; modifiers, clothes and manuals data/scripts own effects and learned recipes.
scripts/lib/run-opts.js + scripts/main-menu.js - mode/run picks; run/quest/story/resume keys swap per mode through SQL slots 91/92 while character and gear remain player.state.
scripts/db.js + scripts/main-menu.js - named save-slot snapshots and hidden Solo/Multiplayer mode snapshots; live character state remains player.state.
scripts/main-menu.js writes solo run.needs/run.sanity switches; scripts/player.js applies needs/sanity drains and scales stamina recovery through scripts/lib/survival.js.
scripts/lib/hub.js noteAtlas, called by scripts/player.js on arrival - player.state.atlas first-seen dates/visit counts; place sims own local texV/signTexV completion stamps.
scripts/lib/level69-quest.js owns player.state.l69q and l69planted; Level 69 sim owns player.state.l69 intro/seat/tunnel/encounter timing and local stream/ghost schedule state.

Level 22 sim owns player.state.l22 arrival/fallen-panel and car-arrival state; scripts/lib/level22-quest.js owns player.state.l22q (visited floors, read records, started/completed quest flags) and journal/payout sync.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered player behavior stack for locomotion, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera, quest, CCTV, radio, barter, phone, emote and god mode.
templates/player.js god-kit.js onInput handles configured U/godMode → editor player.state.god and gear grant; update refills survival values before scripts/player.js core update.
scripts/fall-guard.js holds velocity across place changes for ground streaming; grounded positions refresh session fgSafe, and out-of-bounds restores it or leaves for spawn.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera and aimPt/aimPitch → ballistics/weaponAim; camera uses worldFeetPosition for parented/seated bodies.

Fresh player detected in scripts/main-menu.js → intake/creator then solo laundromat; scripts/lib/laundromat-cut.js plays opening and crosses to tutorial0; tutorial sim/lib/tutorial drive room and guidance.
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; player update calls clockHeal on arrival.

scripts/lib/run-opts.js mpRoom/toSolo → party or personal room; scripts/bonus-door.js → hub.toHub; Bonus glass hall scripts/bonus-l0-exit.js sets bonusBack and routes toSolo(main), then main-menu places player outside return door.

Level 3 door or Boom Town sedan → Level 69 solo instance; Level 69 sim seats player/starts car, streams road and beacon posts; l69-car controls driving, l69-ui reads player.state.l69, and l69-post → level69-quest plants beacon.

Level 69 sim repeats the left tunnel to Level 11 and right ramp to Level 22; right ramp transfers the dead car as l22car, Level 22 lays it in Emstable and the rubble exit returns to Level 21 only after floor 21 is visited.

Level 22 sim startL22/noteFloor + l22-record.js noteRecord → player.state.l22q and quest journal; Wren dialogue from npc-starters/talk dispatches l22Choices/handleDialogueQuest22 and pays completed exploration/records quests.
Level 11 chapter door → levelrun start/alcove; places/levelrun/sim.js dresses run, advances horde/hazards and handles rescue/exit; Level ! exit returns to Level 11.

Asset Library panel searches shipped catalog plus project-local assets; set capture/capture-box gathers scene members → stored set rows, while drag/place, swap, stage previews, motion and effect tools instantiate reusable content.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; dining_set composes table and fitted chairs.

scripts/lib/data/weapons.yml + scripts/player.js + ballistics.js + knock.js + loot.js - weapon variants share combat and rarity/level gates; weights, upgrade rolls and two-handed models/grips vary by tuning.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.
scripts/crawl.js + scripts/player.js + humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - global crawl/crouch and gait; held crouch initiates crawl and tight spaces trigger automatic crawl.
scripts/lib/sleep.js + scripts/interact.js + scripts/rest.js + scripts/l178-prop.js - common bed detection/entry, with ordinary rest and Kyoto futon crossing as distinct outcomes.
scripts/lib/l169-road.js + l169-road-geo.js + l169-travel.js + l169-door.js - checkpoint structures vary by site and geometry kind; streamed props include route boards and animated doors.
places/levelrun/sim.js + scripts/lib/levelrun-mechanics.js - obstacle/hazard corridor varies by position, period and obstacle kind; Agility/stim alter movement/stamina and horde speed.

places/level22/sim.js + scripts/lib/l22-layout.js + l22-deck/cut/panel-geo.js - six decks, scaffold cuts and fragile slabs vary by tier/floor; shared generated geometry and authored dress data create Emstable's social strata.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists; Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js + scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
scripts/lib/data/l178-skins.json - slot-to-texture skin table has no current consumer; x0z0.scene carries material overrides inline.
migrationNotes: Solo and Multiplayer share one character but not run/story state: scripts/lib/run-opts.js isStoryKey defines the swapped key family; MODE_SLOT 91/92 are separate SQL snapshots hidden from ordinary Save Manager slots.

Fresh-player opening chain is main-menu → intake → laundromat → tutorial0; lmDone/arrivePending are player.state flags, while lmSkip and cut timing are session state. These opening places are solo/ephemeral.

Level ! uses places/levelrun/config.yaml solo/ephemeral; CORRIDOR and its 26 m chunk/door generation come from scripts/lib/levelrun-mechanics.js; keep sim geometry and hazard/pursuit/midpoint/collapse/exit depths aligned.

Level 69 slices are 40 m along -Z; the left Level 11 tunnel and right Level 22 ramp repeat every 60 slices (2.4 km), with exits at slice offsets 55 and 28. Preserve the modulo-based sign, tunnel/ramp geometry and streamed slice positions together.

Level 22 layout uses FF=3.2 m floor spacing; scripts/lib/l22-layout.js defines six tiered decks, Cuts, mine/pit and exit, while per-player fallen state in l22 changes panel generation. Quest progress is separately in l22q; do not conflate the two keys.

Level 22 records pair l22-records.yml IDs with pages.yml IDs and quest keys; the read prop passes rec to noteRecord, and Wren in Boom Town is the dialogue/turn-in consumer. The incoming Level 69 car handoff is l22car.
